title: Canvas Interaction Regression After 441
description: Canvas renders but pointer interaction (click, select, deselect) stopped working after commit 441 vs 440; rest of UI OK. Find root cause in diff 440..441 and fix with tests.
summary: Logged full investigation in ticket important.md (re-populated after close). Root cause: `.lm_goldenlayout * { pointer-events: auto !important }` + full-bleed `Window` options overlay (`inset-0`) blocked canvas hits. Fixes: (1) `Window` overlay repositioned to `top-0 right-0 bottom-0 left-auto w-max max-w-[min(11rem,calc(100%-0.5rem))]` so it no longer spans the canvas; (2) CSS `.lm_goldenlayout [data-slot="window-options-overlay"]` + attribute selector with `pointer-events: none !important`; (3) Playwright: `elementsFromPoint` stack asserts canvas appears before window-options subtree + computed pointer-events on overlays. Ran bun ./script.ts test in elements/client/lib/board (Rust 57, Vitest 75, Playwright 3 pass / 3 skip).
